scientific_integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses coprimality, multiplicativity of \(\sigma_s\), and elementary comparisons of \(2^s\) and \(3^s\). Finite computation is regression evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The result disproves both proposed divisibility converses but does not classify every proportional progression with a permanent divisor-sum inequality. The explicit quadruple depends on the sign of \(s\).
title: A multiplicative counterexample scheme for Pongsriiam’s divisor-sum progression converse
